# Synthetic fixture

Generated by `node scripts/make-fixture.mjs` (seed 20240904). Coordinates are fictitious; chromosome names follow Wm82 conventions only in spelling. 500 markers (25 per chromosome, Gm01-Gm20), 2 parents, 6 candidates, 460 informative markers.

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| genotypes.vcf | Primary format; RP allele is REF or ALT at random |
| genotypes.hmp.txt | Same calls as HapMap with `chr` chromosome names and two-letter cells |
| genotypes_wide.csv | Same calls as nucleotide wide CSV with numeric chromosome names |
| genotypes_coded.csv | Informative markers only, coded A/B/H; nonparental becomes N |
| samples.csv | Manifest with one recurrent_parent, one donor_parent, six candidates |
| markers.csv | Positions plus synthetic cM (2.4 cM/Mb) |
| expected.json | Class counts, RPP and donor segments (cM and bp gap criteria) per line, derived from the planted design by a separate implementation |

Planted design per candidate is in the `notes` column of samples.csv.
